title: NhtEvent
description: NHT event carrying prev/curr resolved NHG info for fast-fixup

rnh_prefix.description: Tracked nexthop prefix (with prefix length), e.g. '2064:100::1d/128'

prev_resolved_prefix.description: Prefix previously used to resolve rnh_prefix; empty-family '::/0' or '0.0.0.0/0' when previously unreachable

prev_resolved_nhg_id.description: Zebra NHG ID previously used to resolve rnh_prefix; 0 when previously unreachable

curr_resolved_prefix.description: Prefix currently used to resolve rnh_prefix; empty-family '::/0' or '0.0.0.0/0' when currently unreachable

curr_resolved_nhg_id.description: Zebra NHG ID currently resolving rnh_prefix; 0 when currently unreachable
